t: The Werner aluminium folding work offers 25cm height adjustability on both sides, with 10 different height positions, a single-handed lock, and non-marring feet to protect floors. This slip-resistant platform offers secure working at height, with slip-resistant bumpers for stairwell mode. The compact, lightweight aluminium design with a central, easy-grab carry handle and fold-flat legs offer easy transportation, with a compacted depth of 11cm. Ideal for professionals needing to work on uneven surfaces and along stairways.
